content:
Apple delivered an impressive performance in September, and with several long-awaited product launches expected in October, the momentum looks set to continue.

#1: MacBook Pro / Ultra Refresh with Touchscreen

Mac has long kept its distance from touchscreens, but with the new MacBook Pro (or MacBook Ultra) expected to debut in October, that stance could finally change.

Apple's next-generation MacBook Pro will feature a brand-new industrial design — the first major exterior redesign in five years. In addition to touch support, it will come equipped with an OLED display, Dynamic Island, and may offer an optional C2 cellular modem.

It's been a while since the MacBook Pro got a fresh look, but Mac's avoidance of touchscreens has lasted even longer — touch input has long been the industry norm, yet Apple chose to skip it. I'm very much looking forward to seeing how touch functionality enhances the Mac user experience going forward.

#2: Next-Generation Apple TV 4K

Apple TV hardware updates have never taken this long. The current latest model is still the third-generation Apple TV 4K released in 2022, with no successor in sight since.

Rumour has it we may finally see a new Apple TV 4K arrive in October, with its biggest selling points being the powerful A19 or A19 Pro chip and support for Siri AI features.

Apple raised prices on most of its products this summer, and the Apple TV was among them. This four-year-old Apple TV 4K is now priced at US$199, well above the original US$129 launch price. Hopefully the new model won't see another price hike.

#3: "HomePad"

Rumours of a HomePod with a screen have been circulating for nearly as long as the HomePod itself. They intensified after Mark Gurman published a detailed report in 2024, with the product often referred to as "HomePad".

HomePad is a smart display with a built-in speaker, reportedly set to lead Apple's re-entry into the smart home market. It will run a new operating system that blends elements of iOS, tvOS and watchOS, and will feature a mode similar to StandBy.

Siri AI will be at the core of the product, alongside a built-in camera, customisable widgets, and Apple's own apps including Photos, Notes, Music and Calendar.

Of all the new Apple products expected in October or later, which one are you most looking forward to? Feel free to share in the comments.
